I went to primary school, so I can count my acres and read a seed label, but I decide from what I have seen work with my own eyes. This beans plot is only 0.08 hectares, so one bag of fertilizer would be too much and cost money I need for my maize field. I will plant the local beans I saved from last season, weed them twice with my family, and do all the work ourselves because the plot is too small to pay someone else.
